contexts.text: Still, remains are always preserved.
All these states are so preserved by the Lord with man that not the least of them perishes.
Doctrinals of faith... were preserved for the uses of this posterity.
To pitch it with pitch = preservation from an inundation of cupidities.
Unless the Lord preserved all every moment, all would perish.
The things - which are preserved with man are called remains.
No flesh would be saved.
Thus preservation in connection and form is perpetual creation.
The power of understanding is always preserved for man by the Lord...
To gather = to preserve, etc.
To heap up = to preserve, etc.
The preservation of truth adjoined to good. Signified, Explained.
Thus preservation is perpetual creation. AC 9502. TCR 46:end. TCR 224.
Preservation then. Signified.
Thence the preservation of spiritual life. Signified, Explained.
The preservation, by a complete unition, of good and truth on all sides and for ever, with every exertion and power. Signified, Explained.
Thus the preservation of the Heavens (is signified).
That in ultimates there is... the preservation of interior things in their state. Explained.
To carry upon their shoulder = to preserve them.
The preservation of good in its state was represented also by...
A representative of the Divine preservation of good and truth for ever from mercy. Signified, Explained.
Thus the preservation of the Spiritual Kingdom with all exertion and power. Signified, Explained.
The sustentation of Heaven, and the preservation of good and truth there with all exertion and power. Signified, Explained.
The conjunction and preservation of the middle part. Signified, Explained.
It treats of the conjunction of all the goods and truths of Heaven with the ultimates there, and thence of the preservation of the whole and of all its parts.

The preservation of the celestial goods and truths there... The preservation of the spiritual goods and truths there... The preservation of the natural goods and truths which proceed from the two preceding. Representation.
The preservation of good and truth in the lowest part of Heaven. Signified.
The conjunction and preservation of all things of Heaven through the sphere of Divine good in the externals of the Spiritual Kingdom. Signified.
The preservation by the Lord of good and truth as to all its quality. Signified.
From this (Divine truth) the Heavens... are being perpetually created, that is, preserved; for preservation is perpetual creation.
The sphere of Divine good, through which are conjunction and preservation. Signified, Explained.
To carry = preservation. AC 10192, Explained.
Conjunction with truths on one side, and preservation through them. Signified, Explained.
Conjunction with good on the other side, and preservation through it. Signified, Explained.
Thence preservation in the state. Signified.
Thus the preservation by the Lord of the Church and of all things of the Church. Signified.
Remembrance, when by Jehovah, = preservation.
In the order in which this good has been formed by the Lord through truths... in the same it is preserved by the Lord... for preservation is perpetual formation...
These are (the Reformed) who were preserved (at the Last Judgment).
(The spiritual mind) is preserved by the Lord in its integrity...
Uses to support the body relate to... the preservation of its state.
(Applying) the preservation of state to eternal life.
The preservation of Things after their creation, is the government of the Lord, and is treated of in this Work.
The preservation of all things depends on the conjunction of the Creator with man.
Hence is the conjunction of the created universe with its Creator; and, through the conjunction, the everlasting preservation.
The preservation of the whole is nothing else than the perpetual influx of the Divine good and Divine truth into the forms created thereby.

There are many spheres which proceed from Him; as the sphere of the preservation of the created universe... The conjugial sphere... is the supereminent sphere of the preservation of the created universe by successive generations.
That two universal spheres proceed from the Lord to preserve the universe in its created state: the sphere of procreating; and that of protecting the things procreated. Explained.
That the sphere of the love of procreating... makes periods, through which creation is preserved in its foreseen and provided state. Explained.
The Divine infils all things, and, through its impletion, preserves all things in the created state...
That unless there were one God, the universe could not have been created and preserved. Explained.
The universe has been so created, that God can be omnipresent, and keep each and all things under His auspices, and hold them together as a one for ever, which is to preserve.
That these [essentials] of the Divine love... are the cause of the preservation (also) of the universe. (Explained.)
God also from His omnipotence preserves the universe... and, when anything falls from order. He... redintegrates it.
All the laws of order, through which He preserves the universe, are Truths. Illustrated.
Truth and Good... are the things through which the universe is (also) preserved.
The Ancient Word is preserved in Heaven...
(Taxes) collected for the preservation of our Country.
On this distinct ordination there, depends the preservation of the whole universe.
It is this unity which effects the preservation of the whole.
This relation (between singulars and universals) causes that all things of the universe have been preserved in their integrity from the first day of creation.
Hence is preservation, which is perpetual creation.
Hence depends the preservation of all things in the universe.
The Lord, who loves the preservation of all and each...
The Lord has preserved, from the first man, the more interior things of man...
That the Lord preserves man from all evil. (Explained.)
This wrapping up is preservation...
The Lord constantly preserves man... (Thus) unless the Lord preserved man every moment... he would instantly perish.
But I have been preserved by the Lord.
They have been preserved to the end that...
And both are preserved.
Who is the Creator and Preserver of the universe.
God. 7. 10. Hence from Him is the preservation of the created universe. CanonsNC 11.
God. 8. 10. The preservation of the universe, which is a perpetual creation, is a full testimony that God is omnipotent, omniscient, and omnipresent.
